parameters.query: SELECT json_build_object('collected_mtd',(SELECT round(sum(amount)) FROM xero.payment WHERE payment_type='ACCRECPAYMENT' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND date_trunc('month',date)=date_trunc('month',current_date)),'invoiced_mtd',(SELECT round(sum(total)) FROM xero.invoice WHERE type='ACCREC' AND date_trunc('month',date)=date_trunc('month',current_date)),'ar_outstanding',(SELECT round(sum(amount_due)) FROM xero.invoice WHERE type='ACCREC' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND amount_due>0),'ar_overdue',(SELECT round(sum(amount_due)) FROM xero.invoice WHERE type='ACCREC' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND amount_due>0 AND due_date<current_date),'open_pipeline',(SELECT round(sum(property_amount_in_home_currency)::numeric) FROM hubspot.deal WHERE (_fivetran_deleted IS NULL OR _fivetran_deleted=false) AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted=false) AND property_hs_is_closed IS NOT TRUE),'aspire_balance',(SELECT round(sum(available_balance)::numeric) FROM finance.aspire_accounts WHERE currency_code='SGD'),'leads_mtd',(SELECT count(*) FROM hubspot.contact WHERE date_trunc('month',property_createdate)=date_trunc('month',current_date)),'deals_7d',(SELECT count(*) FROM hubspot.deal WHERE property_createdate >= current_date - interval '7 days'),'total_followers',(SELECT sum(followers) FROM content_perf.metricool_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM content_perf.metricool_snapshots)),'reach_7d',(SELECT sum(views) FROM content_perf.reels WHERE published_date >= current_date - interval '7 days'),'eng_30d',(SELECT round(avg(engagement_rate)::numeric,1) FROM content_perf.reels WHERE engagement_rate IS NOT NULL AND engagement_rate<100 AND published_date >= current_date - interval '30 days'),'won_by_market',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('market',market,'won',won_sgd)) FROM (SELECT CASE property_deal_currency_code WHEN 'SGD' THEN 'Singapore' WHEN 'MYR' THEN 'Malaysia' WHEN 'IDR' THEN 'Indonesia' ELSE 'Other' END AS market, round(sum(property_amount_in_home_currency)) won_sgd FROM hubspot.deal WHERE (_fivetran_deleted IS NULL OR _fivetran_deleted=false) AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted=false) AND property_hs_is_closed_won='true' GROUP BY 1) qm)) AS payload

WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT snapshot_date FROM content_perf.metricool_snapshots ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 2), lat AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) md FROM d), pri AS (SELECT min(snapshot_date) pd FROM d), snap AS (SELECT page, platform, country, snapshot_date, followers FROM content_perf.metricool_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date IN ((SELECT md FROM lat),(SELECT pd FROM pri))), gplat AS (SELECT country, page, platform, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT md FROM lat)) f, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT pd FROM pri)) fp FROM snap WHERE page<>'Koocester' GROUP BY country,page,platform), gpage AS (SELECT country, page, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT md FROM lat)) f, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT pd FROM pri)) fp FROM snap WHERE page<>'Koocester' GROUP BY country,page), ctot AS (SELECT country, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT md FROM lat)) f, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT pd FROM pri)) fp FROM snap WHERE page<>'Koocester' GROUP BY country), mainp AS (SELECT platform, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT md FROM lat)) f, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT pd FROM pri)) fp FROM snap WHERE page='Koocester' GROUP BY platform) SELECT json_build_object('ctot',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('country',country,'f',f,'fp',fp) ORDER BY f DESC) FROM ctot),'geo_page',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('country',country,'page',page,'f',f,'fp',fp)) FROM gpage),'geo_plat',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('country',country,'page',page,'platform',platform,'f',f,'fp',fp)) FROM gplat),'main_total',(SELECT json_build_object('f',sum(f),'fp',sum(fp)) FROM mainp),'main',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('platform',platform,'f',f,'fp',fp)) FROM mainp)) AS geo
